headline: Canada Expects to Finalize EU Associate Member Agreement by June
summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said he expects to conclude negotiations on an unprecedented associate member agreement with the European Union by June.
why: Closer economic and institutional alignment between Canada and the European Union could reduce regulatory barriers, enhance bilateral trade, and expand transatlantic market access.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Deepened economic association with the European Union provides improved market access for Canadian businesses and trade.
